# Shekinah Haitian Seventh-day Adventist Church

> A welcoming Haitian Seventh-day Adventist church in Alvarado, Texas, with Bible centered articles on Bible questions, devotionals, Christian health, and plant based Haitian recipes. Doctrinal articles follow the official Seventh-day Adventist Fundamental Beliefs and quote the King James Version.

Shekinah Haitian Seventh-day Adventist Church is a Haitian Seventh-day Adventist congregation at 205 E Carver St, Alvarado, Texas 76009, serving Johnson County and the Dallas Fort Worth area (Burleson, Mansfield, Cleburne, Fort Worth).

- Sabbath School: Saturday 10:00 AM
- Divine Worship Service: Saturday 11:00 AM
- Prayer meeting: online on Zoom, Tuesday and Wednesday 7:30 PM Central (Meeting ID 818 9375 1524, passcode 123)
- Worship languages: Haitian Creole (Kreyòl), French, and English
- The church family shares a meal after the Sabbath service
- Live worship: https://www.youtube.com/@SHEKINAHHaitianSDA
- Email: info@shekinahsda.org
- Phone: (888) 219-3842
- Beliefs: the 28 Fundamental Beliefs of the Seventh-day Adventist Church (https://www.adventist.org/beliefs/)

## Bible Answers

- [Ancient Empires and Prophecy: The Daniel 2 Timeline Decoded](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/daniel-2-prophecy-explained/): Daniel 2 prophecy explained: Babylon, Medo Persia, Greece, Rome, and the stone kingdom, with dated history, fair views, and hope in Christ's return.
- [Saturday vs. Sunday: How History Shifted the Sabbath Day of Rest](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/history-of-the-sabbath-change-saturday-to-sunday/): The history of the Sabbath change from Saturday to Sunday, traced through Jesus, Justin, Constantine and Laodicea, using the original sources.
- [What Happens One Second After Death? Sleep, Soul, and Resurrection](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/what-happens-one-second-after-death/): What happens one second after death? The Bible calls death a sleep, and the next thing a believer knows is the voice of Jesus at the resurrection.
- [Why Is the Book of Enoch Missing from the Bible? Dead Sea Scrolls & Canon History](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/why-is-the-book-of-enoch-not-in-the-bible/): Why is the book of Enoch not in the Bible? See what the Dead Sea Scrolls show, what Jude quoted, and how Jews and Christians judged the canon.
- [Did Constantine Really Change the Bible? The Truth About the Council of Nicaea (325 AD)](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/did-constantine-change-the-bible/): Did Constantine change the Bible? See what the Council of Nicaea in 325 really decided, why it never voted on the canon, and what ancient sources show.
- [What Does the Bible Say About the Second Coming of Jesus?](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/what-does-the-bible-say-about-the-second-coming-of-jesus/): What does the Bible say about the second coming of Jesus? See how Christ will return, the signs He gave, the rapture question, and how to be ready.
- [Does Hell Burn Forever? What the Bible Really Says About Hell](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/does-hell-burn-forever-what-the-bible-says/): Does hell burn forever? Explore Sheol, Hades, Gehenna, eternal fire, and forever and ever in Scripture, and why God's final judgment reveals His love.
- [What Happens When You Die? What the Bible Really Teaches](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/what-happens-when-you-die-bible/): What happens when you die according to the Bible? A gentle, Scripture based look at death, the resurrection, and the hope of seeing our loved ones again.
- [Why Do Seventh-day Adventists Worship on Saturday?](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/why-do-seventh-day-adventists-worship-on-saturday/): Why do Seventh-day Adventists worship on Saturday? Explore the Bible, history, and heart behind the Sabbath, plus the honest questions people ask most.

## Devotional

- [Giving Thanks When Life Is Hard: Bible Verses About Gratitude](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/giving-thanks-when-life-is-hard/): Bible verses about gratitude for hard seasons: Psalm 100, Habakkuk 3, Paul in prison, and the ten lepers, with simple habits for your table and Sabbath.
- [Resting in His Presence: What the Sabbath Teaches Us About Trust](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/resting-in-his-presence-what-the-sabbath-teaches-us-about-trust/): What does Sabbath rest teach about trusting God? Explore the manna and double portion, Hebrews 4, Matthew 11:28, and simple ways to prepare before sunset.
- [Five Ways to Build Faith at the Dinner Table](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/five-ways-to-build-faith-at-the-dinner-table/): Simple family devotion ideas for dinner: share a blessing, pray for a neighbor by name, read one verse and ask the youngest, and more, rooted in Scripture.
- [When Prayer Feels Quiet](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/when-prayer-feels-quiet/): When prayer feels unanswered, Scripture offers hope. Learn from Hannah, David, Elijah, and Daniel, and what Jesus taught about praying without giving up.
- [Faith for the Journey: Lessons from Abraham](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/faith-for-the-journey-lessons-from-abraham/): Lessons from Abraham's faith for anyone starting over: Hebrews 11:8, his honest failures, Isaac on Moriah, and how to trust God when the road is unclear.

## Health

- [Sunlight in the Shorter Days: Vitamin D, Mood, and God's Gift of Light](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/sunlight-in-the-shorter-days-vitamin-d-and-mood/): How much vitamin D do you need in winter? NIH guidance, plant based sources, darker skin, the winter blues and SAD, plus what the Bible says about light.
- [The Gift of Rest: Why Sleep Is Part of Our Worship](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/the-gift-of-rest-why-sleep-is-part-of-our-worship/): Most adults need 7 or more hours of sleep. Learn what the CDC and NIH say, what the Bible teaches about rest, and simple habits for sleeping better tonight.
- [Walk With Me: Starting a Sabbath Afternoon Walking Group](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/walk-with-me-starting-a-sabbath-afternoon-walking-group/): See the health benefits of walking, how many minutes adults need each week, and how to start a simple Sabbath afternoon walk with family, friends, or church.
- [Water First: Small Habits for Big Energy](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/water-first-small-habits-for-big-energy/): How much water do adults need? See the National Academies figures, signs of dehydration, simple daily water habits, and what Jesus meant by living water.
- [Stress Less: Trusting God With Your Worries](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/stress-less-trusting-god-with-your-worries/): How to manage stress: signs of chronic stress, breathing, exercise and sleep tips from NIMH, CDC and Mayo Clinic, plus Bible verses about worry.

## Recipes

- [Pikliz: The Spicy Haitian Slaw That Brightens Every Sabbath Plate](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/pikliz-the-spicy-haitian-slaw/): An original pikliz recipe for spicy Haitian pickled slaw, with a milder option, how long pikliz lasts, food safety tips, and plant based pairings.
- [Eating for Life: Simple Plant Based Meals from Our Kitchen](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/eating-for-life-simple-plant-based-meals-from-our-kitchen/): Healthy Haitian plates with brown rice diri ak pwa, legim, and mango avocado salad, plus what Loma Linda Adventist research shows about plant based eating.
- [Soup Joumou, Plant Based: A Freedom Tradition for the Whole Table](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/soup-joumou-plant-based-a-freedom-tradition-for-the-whole-table/): Make a hearty plant based soup joumou with squash, vegetables, pasta, epis, and chickpeas, and learn the 1804 freedom story and UNESCO recognition behind it.
- [Diri ak Pwa the Healthy Way](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/diri-ak-pwa-the-healthy-way/): A healthy diri ak pwa recipe with brown rice, dry beans, thyme, clove, and homemade plant based epis, plus why beans and whole grains are so good for you.
- [Legim Without Meat: A Family Favorite](https://shekinahsda.org/blog/legim-without-meat-a-family-favorite/): An original Haitian legim recipe without meat: eggplant, cabbage, carrot, and chayote stew with epis, plus serving ideas and how long legim keeps.

## Etid Biblik an Kreyòl (Haitian Creole Bible studies: audio plus full article)

- [Etid Biblik an Kreyòl](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/): all Haitian Creole audio Bible studies with summaries, articles and Bible verses
- [Èske Jezi se Bondye? Sa Bib la di sou kiyès Jezi ye](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/eske-jezi-se-bondye/): Èske Jezi se Bondye? Yon etid odyo an Kreyòl: sa Jezi te di sou tèt li, poukisa disip yo te adore l, ak poukisa sa chanje lavi ou jodi a.
- [Poukisa Bondye kite soufrans rive? Gwo batay ant byen ak mal](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/poukisa-bondye-kite-soufrans-rive/): Poukisa Bondye kite soufrans rive? Yon etid odyo an Kreyòl dous e plen espwa: istwa Jòb, se pa pinisyon, e Bondye pral siye tout dlo nan je.
- [Kò, nanm, lespri ak souf: Kisa Bib la vrèman di?](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/ko-nanm-lespri-souf/): Ki diferans ki genyen ant kò, nanm, lespri ak souf dapre Bib la? Yon etid odyo an Kreyòl ak mo ebre ak grèk yo, egzanp senp, ak bon nouvèl la.
- [Lè w dekouraje: Bondye ak depresyon](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/le-w-dekouraje/): Èske yon kretyen ka deprime? Yon etid odyo an Kreyòl dous e plen konpasyon: Eli anba pye zèb la, Bondye ak doktè, ti pa ki ka ede, ak espwa nan Jezi.
- [Kijan pou m priye? Yon gid senp pou pale ak Bondye](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/kijan-pou-m-priye/): Kijan pou m priye Bondye? Priyè Papa nou an Kreyòl, priye nan non Jezi, kisa pou di lè ou pa jwenn mo, ak kat ti priyè pou maten, aswè ak fanmi.
- [Èske Bondye ka padone m? Gras ak padon](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/eske-bondye-ka-padone-m/): Èske Bondye ka padone m menm si m fè anpil peche? Yon etid odyo an Kreyòl: pitit gason ki te pèdi a, fanm bò pi a, Pyè, ak kijan pou resevwa padon Bondye.
- [Kisa Bib la di sou Saba a? Yon randevou Bondye pa janm anile](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/kisa-bib-la-di-sou-saba-a/): Kisa Bib la di sou Saba a? Jenèz 2 ak katriyèm kòmandman an nan lang Kreyòl, Jezi ak jou Saba a, samdi oswa dimanch, ki lè Saba a kòmanse, ak kesyon moun poze.
- [Priyè pou gerizon: Èske Bondye geri toujou jodi a?](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/priye-pou-gerizon/): Èske Bondye geri toujou jodi a? Yon etid odyo an Kreyòl ak konpasyon: Jak 5, Bondye ak doktè, lè gerizon an pa vini, ak yon priyè ansanm.
- [Jezi ap retounen! Sa Bib la di sou dezyèm vini Jezi](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/dezyem-vini-jezi/): Kisa Bib la di sou dezyèm vini Jezi? Yon etid odyo an Kreyòl: kijan l ap vini, siy yo, sa k ap rive jou sa a, ak kijan pou nou pare.
- [Kisa Advantis Setyèm Jou yo kwè? Yon vizit zanmi nan kwayans nou yo](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/kisa-advantis-yo-kwe/): Kisa Advantis Setyèm Jou yo kwè? Yon etid odyo an Kreyòl ak kesyon ak ti blag: Bib la, Jezi, sali pa gras, Saba a, sante, ak retou Jezi.
- [Kisa ki rive lè yon moun mouri? Sa Bib la di sou lanmò ak rezirèksyon](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/kisa-ki-rive-le-yon-moun-mouri/): Kisa ki rive lè yon moun mouri dapre Bib la? Yon etid odyo an Kreyòl ak kesyon, ti blag ak espwa: lanmò kòm yon dòmi, rèv ak moun ki mouri, ak rezirèksyon an.
- [Èske Konstanten te chanje Bib la? Verite sou Konsil Nise a](https://shekinahsda.org/kreyol/eske-konstanten-te-chanje-bib-la/): Èske Konstanten te chanje Bib la? Yon etid odyo an Kreyòl sou Konsil Nise a (ane 325), prèv maniskri yo, ak lwa Konstanten te pase an 321.
